headerDisplay: Read-only EG4 Monitor integration for Battery, Grid, Solar, Load, and Generator status.
footerDisplay: Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with EG4 Electronics or Luxpower. Credentials are sent only to the approved EG4 Monitor HTTPS host.

baseUrl.title: EG4 Monitor URL
baseUrl.description: For security, the current release accepts only the official EG4 Monitor HTTPS host.

pollInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often Homebridge refreshes EG4 cloud data. Minimum 60 seconds.

debugApi.title: API Debug Logging
debugApi.description: Logs endpoint-level diagnostics without response bodies or credentials. Enable only while troubleshooting.
